licensing: two26.studio is a real, live studio in Bucharest. Its wordmark, illustrations, team photos, testimonial authors, client logos, client project imagery and videos are real people's likenesses, third-party trademarks or client-owned work. A generated page must never reproduce, trace or imitate them; reference mode may point at them only as evidence for a faithful reconstruction. Fonts are trial/test files with unverified licences (see tokens/00-foundation/typography.json).
